2026-07-31.title: (Sh*t at) Pickup Soccer
2026-07-31.detail:
Pickup soccer with queer women and nonbinary folks!

**6:00-6:15pm** \- Chatting & easy warmup games
**6:15-8:00pm\***\- Play soccer\!\! We play on a half\-size field\, have minimal rules\, and basically scrimmage\. While it's still a bit of a workout\, we don't keep score and we cheer for everyone\, so it's fun and beginner friendly\.
**8:15pm** - Head to [Pitch the Baby](https://www.pitchthebabybar.com/), a nearby women's sports bar, to get food and hang out. If you don't want to play soccer but would like to hang out with us, head to Pitch the Baby at this time.

**What to bring:**
**WATER**, shoes and clothes you can move in.
Cleats and shin guards are optional, we'll provide cones and balls.

**Don't let lack of supplies stop you from showing up!!!** Playing in sneakers and street clothes is totally normal in our group.

**Rules:**

1. Be shit at soccer or bring your "shit-at-soccer" energy
2. **No dudes!** Sorry, guys\*\*
3. Don't be the reason we have to make a third rule

**Parking:** Super easy!! Judkins has a parking lot and tons of free street parking.

**Accessibility:** We take regular water/rest breaks. Most of us are not in shape - especially after taking winter off. Full disclosure: the bathrooms are porta potties and the water fountain is always broken. I don't own a rattle ball, but I'm happy to use it if you bring it. I bring a small first aid kit, extra water bottles, and ice packs.

**Can I come late/leave early?:** Yes! Do whatever works for you - we have people coming as late at 7 and you can always skip the soccer and meet us at Pitch The Baby after.

**Dogs:** This park frequently has off leash dogs running around.

This group is funded by participant donations. Our costs include first aid supplies, water bottles, soccer balls/cones/etc, and a meetup membership - cheap, but not free. Venmo @ellie-ish or contribute to the meetup group fundraiser to donate.

\*\*Nonbinary folks, trans women, and ally women all welcome and invited :)

please check the comments/discussion for updates on plans, host, etc that may change closer to be event ♥️

2026-08-04.title: Pickleball for Beginners at Green Lake (Aug 4)
2026-08-04.detail:
Green Lake Pickleball is hosting FREE Beginner Welcome Courts. Every Tuesday from 5:00pm to 8:30pm, and every Thursday from 11:00am to 2:00pm, courts at Green Lake are dedicated for beginner and intermediate players to learn and play in a friendly, low-pressure environment.

* No experience needed.
* Drop in by yourself, or with friends.
* Wear comfortable shoes and athletic clothing. Bring water and sunscreen.
* Everyone is welcome.

Pickleball Ambassadors are available to teach basic rules, scoring, and court etiquette.

🗓️ Join us Tuesdays at 5:00pm, or Thursdays at 11:00am. We play at the eastern-most courts, nearest to the road. Look for orange traffic cones. (Sessions may be canceled in case of rain.)

**More Info**

* Links: [Website](https://www.greenlakepickleball.org/beginner-welcome-courts/) \| [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/GreenLakePickleball/) \| [Venmo](https://account.venmo.com/u/Green_Lake_Pickleball)
* Donations: Optional [Venmo](https://account.venmo.com/u/Green_Lake_Pickleball) donations of $2 to $4 help us provide equipment, maintain supplies, and keep the program running.
* WhatsApp: Come play with us and get invited to a private WhatsApp community of 300+ local players. (Invite links are shared in-person only.)

2026-08-09.title: Beginner Pickleball Social with Coffee & Donuts (Aug 9)
2026-08-09.detail:
Join us Sunday mornings from 9:00am to 12:00pm for FREE pickleball, coffee, and donuts with the Green Lake community.

Whether you're brand new to pickleball or already a regular at Green Lake, this is a friendly, low-pressure way to meet new people and enjoy the game together over breakfast.

At Beginner Pickleball Social, everyone plays together. Beginners, intermediate players, and Green Lake regulars all join the same paddle queue. It's easy to meet experienced players, make new friends, and join one of Seattle's most active pickleball communities.

What to expect:

* Free coffee ☕ and donuts 🍩! (*while supplies last*)
* Friendly, social pickleball.
* Meet new people from the Green Lake community.
* No experience or partner required.
* Loaner paddles available.

Everyone is welcome. Wear comfortable shoes and athletic clothing. Bring water and sunscreen. Pickleball Ambassadors are available to teach basic rules, scoring, and court etiquette.

🗓️ Join us Sundays at 9:00am. We'll use Green Lake's open-play system, with all eight pickleball courts in one paddle queue.

(Sessions may be canceled in case of rain.)

**More Info**

* Links: [Website](https://www.greenlakepickleball.org/beginner-welcome-courts/) \| [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/GreenLakePickleball/) \| [Venmo](https://account.venmo.com/u/Green_Lake_Pickleball)
* Donations: Optional [Venmo](https://account.venmo.com/u/Green_Lake_Pickleball) donations of $2 to $4 help us provide equipment, maintain supplies, and keep the program running.
* WhatsApp: Come play with us and get invited to a private WhatsApp community of 300+ local players. (Invite links are shared in-person only.)
